CustomField.formula: TEXT(Assessment_Type__c) & " - " & LPAD(TEXT(MONTH(DATEVALUE(CreatedDate))), 2, "0") & "/" & LPAD(TEXT(DAY(DATEVALUE(CreatedDate))), 2, "0") & "/" & TEXT(YEAR(DATEVALUE(CreatedDate))) & " - " & IF( ISBLANK(CreatedBy.FirstName), CreatedBy.LastName, CreatedBy.FirstName & " " & CreatedBy.LastName )
CustomField.label: Assessment Name
